translated_question: Ngay bây giờ tôi có thể đến một tòa nhà kiên cố một cách an toàn. Cầu vượt gần đó có phải là chỗ trú lốc xoáy tốt hơn không?
madlad_backtranslation_en: Right now, I can get to a fortified building safely. Is the nearby bridge a better cyclone shelter?
vinai_backtranslation_en: Right now I can get to a permanent building safely. Is the nearby flyover a better tornado shelter?

english_original: Tornado warning outside. Building right here and safe to reach. Hide under the overpas?
translated_question: Tôi đang ở ngoài trời khi có cảnh báo về cơn lốc xoáy. Tòa nhà ở ngay đây và tôi có thể đến đó một cách an toàn. Tôi có nên chọn chỗ dưới gầm cầu vượt để trú ẩn không? Tôii hỏi vậy.
madlad_backtranslation_en: I was outside when there was a cyclone warning. The building is right here and I can get there safely. Should I choose a place under the bridge to take shelter? That's what I'm asking.
vinai_backtranslation_en: I was outside when there was a tornado warning. The building is right here and I can get there safely. Should I take shelter under the overpass? That's my question.

english_original: I am outdoors during the tornado and cannot reach a building. How should I protect my head, neck, and body?
translated_question: Tôi đang ở ngoài trời trong cơn lốc xoáy và không thể đến một tòa nhà. Tôi nên bảo vệ đầu, cổ và cơ thể như thế nào?
madlad_backtranslation_en: I'm outside in a cyclone and I can't get to a building. How should I protect my head, neck and body?
vinai_backtranslation_en: I'm outside in a tornado and can't get to a building. How should I protect my head, neck and body?

english_original: I am trapped after a tornado and there is dust around me. Should I keep shouting for help?
translated_question: Tôi bị mắc kẹt sau lốc xoáy và xung quanh có bụi. Tôi có nên tiếp tục la hét cầu cứu không?
madlad_backtranslation_en: I'm stuck behind a cyclone and there's dust all around. Should I keep shouting for help?
vinai_backtranslation_en: I'm trapped behind a tornado and there's dust all around. Should I keep screaming for help?

english_original: What should I do to signal rescuers while trapped in a dusty space after a tornado?
translated_question: Sau lốc xoáy, khi bị mắc kẹt trong chỗ có nhiều bụi, tôi nên làm gì để ra hiệu cho người cứu hộ?
madlad_backtranslation_en: After a cyclone, when I'm stuck in a dusty place, what should I do to signal rescuers?
vinai_backtranslation_en: After a tornado, when stuck in a dusty spot, what should I do to signal the rescuer?

english_original: Trapped after tornaddo, lots of dust. Should I shout or signal some other way?
translated_question: Sau cơn lốc xoáy, tôi bị mắc kẹt và xung quanh có nhiều bụi. Tôi nên la hét hay dùng một cách khác để phát tín hiệu cầu cứu? Tôii muốn biết.
madlad_backtranslation_en: After the cyclone, I was trapped and there was a lot of dust around. Should I scream or use some other way to signal for help? I want to know.
vinai_backtranslation_en: After the tornado, I got trapped and there was a lot of dust around. Should I scream or use another way to signal for help? I want to know.

english_original: I am safely outside after the tornado, have no emergency, and only want to tell family I am safe. Should I make repeated phone calls or use text messages?
translated_question: Tôi đã ở ngoài an toàn sau lốc xoáy, không có tình huống khẩn cấp và chỉ muốn báo cho gia đình biết mình an toàn. Tôi nên gọi điện nhiều lần hay gửi tin nhắn?
madlad_backtranslation_en: I've been out safely after the cyclone, no emergencies and just wanted to let my family know I'm safe. Should I call you more than once or send you a text?
vinai_backtranslation_en: I was out of harm's way after the tornado, there was no emergency, and I just wanted to let my family know I was safe. Should I make multiple phone calls or send texts?
